# Words and Terms — Tackle Content Style

Source: [Words and terms](https://appdirect.jira.com/wiki/spaces/PC/pages/5727191880/Words+and+terms) (Confluence)

## Cloud Marketplace Names

Always use the exact proper name. Alphabetize when listing in a series.

| Proper name | Short form | Avoid |
|-------------|------------|-------|
| AWS Marketplace | AWS | Amazon, Amazon Marketplace |
| Microsoft commercial marketplace | Microsoft | Azure Marketplace, Azure, MSFT |
| Google Cloud Marketplace | Google Cloud | GCP, GCM, Google |

When speaking generally, use "cloud marketplace" (lowercase). Use "marketplace" alone only when the specific marketplace is already identified in context.

Sellers and buyers transact **on** or **through** the marketplace.

## Cloud Provider vs. Cloud Partner

| Term | Meaning | Avoid |
|------|---------|-------|
| cloud provider | AWS, Microsoft, Google Cloud as infrastructure/platform providers | "cloud" alone, "cloud service provider" |
| cloud partner | AWS, Microsoft, Google Cloud when providing leads or co-sell referrals | Using ambiguously without context |
| cloud partner program | ACE (AWS), Microsoft Cloud Partner Program, Google Cloud Partner Advantage | Abbreviations without first-use expansion |

Never shorten "cloud provider" to "cloud." Always use context to distinguish provider from partner.

## Core Tackle Terminology

| Use | Avoid | Context |
|-----|-------|---------|
| co-sell opportunity | deal, co-sell referral, co-sell record, co-sell deal | Always include the modifier: "co-sell opportunity" |
| opportunity | deal, offer (when meaning a sales opportunity) | A potential future sale for an account |
| offer | deal | A conditional proposal (product, price, terms) |
| private offer | Private Offer (title case), DPO | Direct-to-buyer offer with unique terms |
| partner private offer | PPO, CPPO | ISV extends to channel partner (reseller) |
| buyer | customer | The organization purchasing your product |
| product | solution, SKU, listing, tier, plan, package | What the ISV sells on the marketplace |
| company | organization, group, entity | An ISV's business |
| listing | (see glossary for full definition) | A published product on a marketplace |
| marketplace revenue | GMV, revenue | Gross revenue measured at disbursement |
| Tackle subscription | plan, program, package, contract | How customers purchase Tackle |
| Tackle Support | contact support, email Tackle support | Always proper noun; link to support@tackle.io |
| pipeline scores | "scoring" (as a label), Prospect | Use "pipeline scores" at first mention; "scores" after |

## Co-Sell Action Verbs

| Action | Use | Avoid |
|--------|-----|-------|
| Submit a co-sell opportunity | send, share, refer | When sharing from ISV to cloud |
| Accept | approve | Receiving something offered — no judgment implied |
| Approve | accept | When an ops manager judges a request |
| Decline | reject | Turning down an opportunity |
| Close as won / Close as lost | (n/a) | Final disposition of a co-sell |
| Register deal for credit | launch (AWS term) | Post-close credit registration |

## Co-Sell Direction

| Term | Meaning | Avoid |
|------|---------|-------|
| inbound | Shared from cloud provider to ISV | AO (Amazon Originated) |
| outbound | Shared from ISV to cloud provider | PO (Partner Originated) |

## UI Interaction Verbs

| Verb | Use for |
|------|---------|
| click | Buttons, navigation, links. Includes "right-click", "double-click", "drag and drop" |
| select | Radio buttons, dropdowns, checkboxes, multi-selects |
| create | Making something from scratch |
| remove | Soft/undoable delete |
| delete | Permanent, irreversible removal |
| configure | Specific setup (permissions, settings) |
| connect | Establishing data flow or human connection |
| set up | General preparation steps; noun/adjective form: "setup" |

Never: "click on", "select on."

## General Terms

| Use | Avoid | Notes |
|-----|-------|-------|
| sign in / sign out | log in / log out | Verb: "sign in"; noun/adjective: "sign-in" |
| left menu | left nav | Navigation menu in the Tackle application |
| dropdown | drop-down | Per Microsoft style guide |
| pop-up | popup, pop up | Hyphen for noun and adjective; "pop up" for verb |
| administrator | admin | Unless part of an official name (e.g., "Storage Admin") |
| organization | org | Unless part of an official name |
| for example | e.g., ie., i.e. | Plain English always |
| with, by way of | via | Plain English always |
| auto-create | (use "create" with external audiences) | Internal term only; hyphen for verb and adjective |
| auto-populate | auto populate, autopopulate | Always hyphenated |
| resale, resell, reseller | re-sale, re-sell, re-seller | No hyphen |
| field mapper | data mapper, data mapping, mapper | Official Tackle feature name for Salesforce integrations |

## Tackle Way — Cross-Cloud Term Mapping

When the same concept uses different terms across clouds, use the Tackle Way term in product UI.

| Definition | Tackle Way | AWS | Microsoft |
|------------|-----------|-----|-----------|
| Turning down an opportunity | declined | Rejected | Declined |
| The co-sell record shared | co-sell opportunity | co-sell opportunity | referral / deal |
| Sharing an opportunity with the cloud | Submit a co-sell opportunity | add / submit | create / new deal |
| Receiving an opportunity | accept | (n/a) | (n/a) |
| Closing a deal | close as won | launch | register |
| Deal registration for credit | register deal for credit | launch | register |
| Opportunity from cloud to ISV | inbound | AWS referral | inbound |
| Opportunity from ISV to cloud | outbound | partner referral | outbound |
| ISV-to-channel-partner offer | partner private offer (PPO) | Resell Opportunity (CPPO) | Partner Private Offer (MPPO) |
| Channel-partner-to-buyer offer | partner-to-buyer offer (PBO) | Channel Partner Private Offer (CPPO) | Multi Party Private Offer (MPPO) |

## Acronyms Reference

Spell out on first use. Second mention may use acronym alone.

| Acronym | Full form |
|---------|-----------|
| ACE | APN Customer Engagements |
| ABO | Agreement Based Offer |
| AMI | Amazon Machine Image |
| AMMP | AWS Marketplace Management Portal |
| CRM | Customer relationship management |
| CPPO | Channel Partner Private Offer |
| CSP | Cloud Solution Provider |
| DPO | Distribution Private Offer |
| DSOR | Distributor Seller of Record |
| FPS | Flexible Payment Scheduler |
| IAM | Identity and Access Management |
| ISV | Independent software vendor (internal term; use "you" in copy) |
| M2M | Machine to Machine |
| MPPO | Multi Party Private Offer |
| MSP | Solution Provider |
| SEO | Search engine optimization (lowercase in running copy) |
| SPPO | Solution Provider Private Offer |

## Integration Names

Use the official name at first mention. Shorten on subsequent mentions.

| First mention | Subsequent mentions |
|---------------|-------------------|
| Tackle for Salesforce integration | Salesforce integration |
| Tackle - Marketo integration | integration |
| Slack integration | integration |

Do not call the Salesforce integration a "connector." Do not call marketplace connections "integrations" — those are core functionality.
